say:1:1422617001:1.text: Scared me to death! One of them just pounced on me out of nowhere!
say:1:1422617001:1.source_cn: 呼啊，吓、吓死我了！那玩意突然就扑上来！

say:2:1422617002:1.text: Aren't these monsters from Sal'thorin? What are they doing here?
say:2:1422617002:1.source_cn: 萨洛克兰那边的尖耳朵变的怪物，怎么会出现在这里啊！

choice_prompt:3:1422617002.text: Aren't these monsters from Sal'thorin? What are they doing here?
choice_prompt:3:1422617002.source_cn: 萨洛克兰那边的尖耳朵变的怪物，怎么会出现在这里啊！

say:4:1422617003:1.text: Yeah, I used to watch over the mines and occasionally saw a few of these things. But it's strange to encounter this many here.
say:4:1422617003:1.source_cn: 我以前是负责看矿洞的，偶尔会遇到这种东西！但在这个地方...

choice_prompt:5:1422617003.text: Yeah, I used to watch over the mines and occasionally saw a few of these things. But it's strange to encounter this many here.
choice_prompt:5:1422617003.source_cn: 我以前是负责看矿洞的，偶尔会遇到这种东西！但在这个地方，遇见这么几个就太奇怪了！

say:6:1422617004:1.text: The destruction found in the village must've been the work of the corrupted Essail. Things will get more dangerous if they've increased their hunting range.
say:6:1422617004:1.source_cn: 村里的那些痕迹应该也是孽化的艾塞勒搞得。活动范围扩散到...

say:7:1422617005:1.text: It's unclear if the attacks will spread the corruption among the dwarves, but getting injured may be unavoidable.
say:7:1422617005:1.source_cn: 也不清楚孽化者袭击矮人后会不会引发传染，但受伤总是避免...

say:8:1422617006:1.text: So, what do we do?! We still have a lot of work piled up!
say:8:1422617006:1.source_cn: 这可咋办啊？我们还得干活呢！

say:9:1422617007:1.text: Don't worry! We're going to report everything to the envoy!
say:9:1422617007:1.source_cn: 别担心，我们就是去找特使汇报的。

say:10:1422617008:1.text: You mean the Lightbearer envoy...? Uh, okay, I guess. Just please help us!
say:10:1422617008:1.source_cn: 啊，耀光的特使啊……算了算了，能解决问题就好，拜托你们了！
